posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
“Grand Theft Auto VI” generated $3.79 billion in sales on its first day, Rockstar Games said. The studio called it the biggest entertainment launch in history, a record that spans film, music and games.

Rockstar said it sold 32.5 million copies in preorders.
posts.text_ko:

락스타는 선주문으로 3,250만 장을 팔았다고 밝혔다.
